verdict.rationale: Poke offers integrations and MCP-based tool access to cloud services (email, calendar, GitHub, Linear, Webflow) and a local dev tunnel (`poke tunnel http://localhost:3000/mcp`) that lets it call a locally running MCP server, but there is no evidence of true desktop 'see and operate applications' capability (screen reading, GUI automation, mouse/keyboard control) as a computer-use agent would provide. missing for 10: evidence of screen/GUI perception, direct desktop app control, and independent corroboration of local-machine task execution beyond a dev MCP tunnel.
